head_commit.message:
Measure shell snapshot use and wait time per command (#51347)

## What changed

Add `codex.shell_snapshot.command` and `codex.shell_snapshot.wait_ms` metrics for eligible command preparations in the unified exec runtime and exec server. Tag observations with snapshot version, availability state, and whether replay was selected (`used`) or normal shell startup was used (`fallback`). Exclude background prewarming from command observations; `used` measures replay selection, not successful restoration or command completion.

## Testing

Extend snapshot retry tests to verify command counts and wait observations across fallback and recovery, excluding prewarm captures. Extend credential-broker approval tests to verify one `protected` snapshot observation for login-shell commands.
